method: Complete and sign the company's optional freeze/alert form and return it by mail, or call the company. The form is a convenience rather than mandatory.
identity: The freeze form requests name and other names, driver-license details or two alternative IDs, SSN/date of birth, current address, recent previous addresses from the past 2 years, request selection and signature. A phone number is optional.
account_or_pin: MicroBilt generally issues a PIN or password for managing the freeze. If it has no report on file, it creates a freeze record and sends confirmation without a PIN/password.
lift: Contact MicroBilt with identity proof, the issued PIN/password if any, and the removal or temporary-release request. A temporary release can specify a company or a period.
prescreen: MicroBilt offers its own preapproved/prescreened, affiliate-sharing and marketing opt-outs. This affects MicroBilt information and is separate from the major-bureau OptOutPrescreen route.
notes: A MicroBilt freeze applies only to reports it creates and maintains. If it has no report, it creates a freeze record and sends confirmation without a PIN or password.
